logp.method_description: The log P of the rhenium complexes was determined using the shake flask method, as described previously.[46,83] An orbital shaker was used to shake a known amount of each complex (ReL1-ReL6) suspended in water (pre-saturated with n-Octanol) for 48 hours. The solution was centrifuged for 10 minutes at 3000 rpm to allow phase separation. Different ratios (v/v, 0.5:1, 1:1, and 2:1) of the saturated solutions were shaken with pre-saturated n-Octanol for 20 minutes on an orbital shaker to get the partition coefficient. The quantity of ruthenium in saturated aqueous solution was then determined by ICP-MS.
